candidates.name: Mississippi Pot Roast
candidates.why: The internet-famous 5-ingredient slow-cooker roast - every component is board-tracked and it shreds/weigh-and-divides perfectly over mashed potatoes. No pot-roast-of-this-style in the catalog. Board note: source au jus gravy mix maps to tracked Brown Gravy Mix (Onion Soup Mix also works). Source 481 cal/44g is the meat+jus; over mashed potato ~650 cal. HIGH confidence.

ingredients: 1 ounce au jus gravy mix (low sodium)

candidates.name: Cuban Ropa Vieja
candidates.why: Cuban shredded-beef braise (tomato/pepper/olive) - a Latin classic with no analog in the catalog; flank steak, olives, pimientos (Roasted Red Peppers) and diced tomatoes are all board-tracked. Board note: the 1/4 cup dry white wine/sherry deglaze is optional (omit or use tracked Red Wine). Source 246 cal/26g is meat+sauce; over rice and black beans ~520. MED confidence on gate (needs the starch).

ingredients: Fresh chopped cilantro or parsley, lime juice/wedges, extra olives and pimientos for garnish

candidates.name: Peruvian Lomo Saltado
candidates.why: Peru's national dish - a Chinese-Peruvian beef stir-fry served OVER french fries and rice. Both fries and Aji Amarillo Paste are board-tracked, and no lomo saltado exists in the catalog. Source publishes 565 cal/48.5g protein as served - clears the dinner gate outright. Batch skillet. HIGH confidence.

ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds flank steak sliced into 3-inch long thin strips against the grain
1 medium red onion chopped into large wedge pieces
French fries and rice for serving

candidates.name: Filipino Beef Mechado
candidates.why: Filipino tomato-soy beef braise - distinct from the catalog Filipino Beef Caldereta (no liver spread; brighter tomato-citrus). Beef chuck, tomato sauce, soy, potato all board-tracked; carrots/bell pepper are common tracked additions. Source 361 cal/31g is meat+potato+sauce; over rice ~560. HIGH confidence on protein, MED on gate.

candidates.name: Beef Chile Colorado
candidates.why: Authentic Mexican dried-chile beef braise - distinct from the catalog Beef Chili Rice Bowls (that is a chili-powder-and-beans chili; this is a pure guajillo/ancho/arbol chile-puree stew, no beans). All three dried chiles are board-tracked. Source 328 cal/37g is meat+sauce; over rice/beans ~530. HIGH confidence on protein, MED on gate.

ingredients: 1 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, divided, plus more to taste
2 pounds beef stew meat, like chuck shoulder or roast, cut into 1/2-inch chunks
